name: James Jr.
bioAdditions: The tree's 'James (Living)', child of James Petriello and Mollie, is the 'brother Jim Petriello and wife MaryEllen' who survived John T. Petriello Sr. in March 2025 (S1). The obituary also confirms that Sr. was 'the son of the late James and Mollie Petriello' (S1). Jim does not appear in the April 1940 household, which held only John (7) and Ann Marie (6) (S2), so he was born later, after 1940 (round 4 found that the 1950 census shows the same two children).

conflicts.assessment: MERGE RECOMMENDATION: I282695504092 and M0004 are the same person. Round 4 already showed that I282695504011 'Mollie Petriello' is a duplicate of H0332 Carmela 'Mollie' Gianetta, so both James entries have the same parents. Keep M0004 (it holds the obituary link) or keep I282695504092 (it holds the tree citation), add the aka 'Jim', spouse MaryEllen, and the parent pair I282695504010 + H0332.
